patterns.name: Moonlit Bat Hair Clip
patterns.approx_size: about 7 cm wide, excluding the clip
patterns.construction: A flat bat silhouette is crocheted in one piece, lightly shaped, then sewn securely onto a snap hair clip.
patterns.summary: A lightweight dark bat appliqué mounted on a hair clip, creating a gentle Halloween finishing touch for children or adults.

patterns.name: Lavender Witch-Hat Brooch
patterns.construction: A small pointed hat and curved brim are crocheted separately, joined together, and finished with a brooch fastening on the back.
patterns.summary: A petite witch-hat brooch with a soft curved brim, designed to pin onto a cardigan, scarf, costume, or treat bag.

patterns.name: Candy-Corn Bag Charm
patterns.approx_size: about 6 cm tall, excluding the loop
patterns.construction: A small tapered candy-corn charm is worked in stacked colour sections with a hanging loop made as part of the final edge.
patterns.summary: A small striped candy-corn charm with a hanging loop for clipping to a treat bag, zip pull, or key ring.

combinations.title: Little Halloween Accessory Set
combinations.intro: Use the three separate accessories together to add coordinated moonlit Halloween details to a costume, outerwear, or trick-or-treat bag.

items.name: Costume and Treat-Bag Trio
notes: Wear the bat hair clip and witch-hat brooch as lightweight costume accents.
Attach the candy-corn charm to a treat bag or zip pull for a matching seasonal detail.
